verification.method: Hand-curated against the official Google Gemini 3 thinking contract (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs): requests carry generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel with the documented vocabulary MINIMAL | LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH, and Gemini 3 Flash / Flash-Lite cannot fully disable thinking (MINIMAL is the floor). Levels map same-name; off: null keeps an unset level at the provider default instead of forwarding an unsupported off.
verification.result: Effort vocabulary is documented, not probed: values are taken from the official Gemini 3 API contract, which pi's google-generative-ai adapter forwards verbatim as thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel.

Hand-curated against the official DeepSeek thinking-mode contract (api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode): chat completions accept thinking {type: enabled|disabled} plus reasoning_effort {low, high, max}. The relay forwards the request body to DeepSeek. Levels map to the nearest supported effort — a same-name map would forward an invalid "medium" — and off: null keeps an unset level at the provider default instead of silently disabling thinking.
verification.result: Effort vocabulary is documented, not probed: the relay is user-configured, so values are taken from the official API contract.

verification.method: Hand-curated against the jellytoken OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions contract: reasoning_effort accepts low | medium | high for some reasoning models. off is omitted so an unset/off level sends no reasoning_effort. xhigh/max are omitted (not in the documented vocabulary).
verification.result: Effort vocabulary is documented, not probed: the relay is user-configured, so values are taken from the official API contract.

verification.method: 探测 + 官方契约：经 jellytoken 中转实测 reasoning_effort low/medium/high/max 均返回 HTTP 200 且推理发生，并对照 Moonshot Kimi K3 官方契约（reasoning_effort 接受 low | high | max，默认 max；模型始终推理，无 thinking 开关）。实测 medium 被上游软接受，但官方词汇不含 medium，故按 deepseek 条目同法保守映射到 high；off: null 保持未设置级别时不发送参数，走上游默认（始终思考）。
verification.result: 探测：21 个 (model, effort) 组合均返回 HTTP 200 且推理确实发生；官方契约：kimi-k3 接受 reasoning_effort low/high/max（默认 max）且始终思考。medium 实测被中转软接受，但官方词汇无 medium，保守映射到 high。

verification.method: 探测 + 官方契约：经 jellytoken 中转实测 reasoning_effort low/medium/high/xhigh/none 均返回 HTTP 200 且推理发生，并对照 Qwen 3.8 Max 官方契约（enable_thinking + reasoning_effort 接受 low | medium | xhigh，默认 xhigh；none 显式禁用思考）。off 映射到 none 而非省略参数，否则 off 会保持默认 xhigh 思考不关；max 上游无此值，映射到 xhigh。
verification.result: 探测：21 个 (model, effort) 组合均返回 HTTP 200 且推理确实发生；官方契约：qwen3.8-max 使用 enable_thinking + reasoning_effort low/medium/xhigh（默认 xhigh），none 禁用思考。上游无 max，映射到 xhigh。
